result: The draft holds. Register, construction patterns, and vocabulary stay within the corpus range throughout. Several markers actively confirm the voice: the short declarative opener ("Digital access to public court records should not depend on expensive private databases") mirrors the court-records corpus opener ("Court records belong to the public"); the parenthetical asides are identical in kind to corpus usage; the rhetorical question paragraph ("Who gets to know what a court has done when the answer depends on a subscription?") matches the KIDS Act piece's run of "Can teens discuss addiction and recovery?"-style questions; and "A disclaimer does not magically eliminate the barrier" is near-verbatim from the KIDS Act corpus sample ("a disclaimer doesn't magically eliminate legal risk"). I noted two vocabulary items — "specialized workflows" and "premium research feature" — that sit toward the edge of the corpus range, but neither reaches high confidence and the instructions bar reporting low findings without a high-confidence anchor nearby. No high-confidence deviation was found. CLEAN.
